work.title: Dance Club Records
work.description: Red brick wall bearing layered graffiti: a large blue spray-painted skull with lettering at top, a white oval panel stenciled 'DANCE CLUB RECORDS' at center, and a white outline snowman stack at left. Lower right features a black-and-white eye motif; scattered tags, a heart outline, and white circular patterns fill remaining surface areas.
work.composition: central skull with text panel on red brick
